svg.title: Otomoto Customer Churn ML Pipeline Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end ML pipeline from data ingestion through deployment and monitoring, showing cloud components, interoperability points, and data flow for the Otomoto churn prediction system.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the Teleconnect dataset source')
sendPrompt('What does Azure Data Factory do in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in Azure Data Lake Gen2?')
sendPrompt('What preprocessing steps run in Databricks?')
sendPrompt('What does the data quality gate check?')
sendPrompt('What models are trained in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does MLflow track in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in the Azure ML Model Registry?')
sendPrompt('What does the CI/CD pipeline check before promoting a model?')
sendPrompt('What does the batch deployment endpoint do?')
sendPrompt('When is the real-time endpoint used?')
sendPrompt('How does the model output reach the marketing team?')
sendPrompt('What triggers a model retrain in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does the retrain trigger connect back to training?')

svg.text: Interoperability labels shown on arrows: artifact format crossing each boundary
